models.candidate_reason: 明确用于 AMP 活性预测，且被用于下游实验验证，具有 benchmark 潜力，但原始训练信息缺失
blocking_issues: 原始模型出处不明，训练数据、代码均未提供，仅作为工具被引用

models.architecture_or_algorithm: trained on 1160 AMP and 1160 non-AMP sequences; outperformed Antimicrobial Peptide Scanner vr.2, iAMPpred, AMPlify
models.candidate_reason: 新提出的 AMP 预测模型，在论文中与主流工具对比并展现优势，但代码和数据集未公开
blocking_issues: 无代码仓库，训练数据未公开

models.architecture_or_algorithm: integrates protein language models and machine learning algorithms; 21 models targeting antimicrobial, antiviral, antibacterial activity
models.input_features: peptide sequences (sequence-based features from protein language models)
models.candidate_reason: 提出了新的 AMP 检测流程，使用蛋白语言模型，性能优于现有方法，但代码和训练数据未公开
blocking_issues: 无代码仓库，训练数据描述不完整

models.architecture_or_algorithm: two-stage approach with RNN; 8 feature encodings (AAC, ASDC, DP, GAAC, CKSAAGP, Moran, NMBroto, PseKRAAC); probabilistic features from 6 best base classifiers (KNN, RF, XGB, EX, Voting, RNN); final RNN meta-model
models.input_features: protein sequences (multiple feature encodings: AAC, ASDC, CKSAAGP, etc.)
models.dataset_source_or_link: not_reported_in_available_evidence (combined dataset from XUAMP, DBAASP, LAMP, DRAMP)
models.candidate_reason: AMP identification model with high reported accuracy and web server, suitable for benchmark but lacks code
blocking_issues: No code repository; web server only, may not be suitable for large-scale offline benchmarking

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Dual diffusion model with sequence diffusion (Transformer-based denoising) and structure diffusion (Graph Attention Network), multi-view feature construction, multi-head cross-attention fusion, single-modal and dual-modal contrastive learning
models.input_features: Amino acid sequence (ESM2 embeddings, BLOSUM62, PAM120, hydrophobicity, helical tendency, AAindex) and predicted tertiary structure (PDB, graph with node features from amino acid type, coordinates, AAindex, edge features from distances, potentials)
models.candidate_reason: AMP classification model with code and data available, suitable for inclusion in benchmark comparison

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Deep neural network with fully connected layers and transformer encoders, using feature vectors inferred by UniRep and ProtT5
models.input_features: Feature vectors from UniRep (1900D) and ProtT5 (1024D) inferred from amino acid sequences
models.dataset_source_or_link: not_reported_in_available_evidence (dataset constructed from public AMP databases, no direct download link)
models.candidate_reason: AMP prediction model with web server, published results, useful for benchmark
blocking_issues: No code repository found, only web server; reproducibility may be limited

important_evidence: AMP-RNNpro web server is available at http://13.126.159.30/ (PMID 38839785)
DDM model code and data are available at https://github.com/kww567upup/DDM (PMID 41692989)
UniAMP web server is available at https://amp.starhelix.cn (PMID 39799358)
AP_Sin achieved 94.61% accuracy outperforming several mainstream tools (PMID 38416364)
AMP-Detector used protein language models and achieved >83% precision (PMID 39201537)
iAMPCN was used for peptide activity prediction but original training data and code are missing (PMID 39330266)
uncertainties: Batch 84 provided AMP-RNNpro source DOI 10.1016/j.csbj.2022.07.043 and PMCID PMC9421197, which do not match the correct publication (DOI 10.1038/s41598-024-63461-6, PMCID PMC11153637) associated with PMID 38839785. This discrepancy may indicate a data error in the original chunk.
The DDM paper is from 2026, which may be an error (future year) or a preprint; further verification needed.
iAMPCN lacks any original paper, training data, or code; its validity as a benchmark candidate is uncertain.
AMP-Detector's training data details are incomplete; only Peptide Atlas was mentioned for discovery, not for training.
The antiviral peptide paper (PMID 41594075) is of unclear relevance to general AMP classification and was included only because of repository links.
